statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk is low at 14 while Stress stays elevated at 49.
recommendation: Tail sits well below the block threshold, so the mapped state is EA_ON for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. The decisive evidence is that the session's gap-down was fully retraced rather than extended. Stress remains elevated on 24-year-high long-end yields, Brent above $100 and a narrow, megacap-led recovery. The one named caution window is Thursday's 17:00-19:00 UTC block containing the 30-year bond auction and a Fed speaker, where a duration-driven second leg is the main conditional risk.
headline: NDX fully retraces its gap-down into the close as the 10-year eases from a 24-year high of 5.36%
body: The Nasdaq-100 trades near 31,120, down about 0.33% against Tuesday's record 31,224.69 close. The path matters more than the level: the index gapped down to open at 30,976.25, fell to 30,904.46, and has since recovered the entire decline to print a 31,148.04 session high. A completed retracement of that size is the opposite of the persistent no-retracement structure that Tail measures, which is why Tail eases to 14 from 15 even with roughly half an hour of cash trading left. Volatility is decaying in parallel: VIX is near 15.10 after a 16.01 session high. The September 15-16 FOMC minutes, released at 18:00 UTC, were hawkish, showing a unanimous 12-0 vote for the quarter-point hike to 3-3/4 to 4 percent and most participants judging another increase likely appropriate by year end. Price discovery since has been orderly rather than one-way: the 10-year yield has eased to about 5.28% after touching 5.36%, its highest since April 2002, and the 30-year has pared back from 5.73%, helped by a 10-year auction that stopped at 5.300%. Stress stays elevated at 49 because the backdrop remains genuinely difficult and internally conflicted. Long-end yields sit at multi-decade highs, Brent trades near $101 with continuing tanker attacks around the Strait of Hormuz and a Gulf storm disrupting offshore staffing, September consumer inflation expectations came in at 3.9% against a 3.7% consensus, and the recovery is narrow: the PHLX Semiconductor Index is down 1.52% at 13,016.97 and the Russell 2000 is off about 1.2%, while bitcoin fell below $83,000 and gold dropped 1.26%. That conflict reduces directional conviction and lifts Stress without establishing a pathological price path. Confidence is 89 on current verified index, volatility, yield, oil, semiconductor and breadth levels plus the actual minutes text; the shared Finviz context file was stale and partial at this run and was therefore not used. Looking forward, the dominant scheduled checkpoint is Thursday's 30-year bond auction at 17:00 UTC followed by a Fed speaker at 17:40 UTC, with September CPI on 14 October the next high-impact release.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock hours carry a published Claude assessment. Risk was low and mean-reverting through the late 6 October session and the Asian and early European hours of 7 October, with Tail between 10 and 14. From 11:00 to 14:00 UTC a trend-down phase lifted Tail to a 23 peak and Stress to 54 as long-end yields pushed to multi-decade highs ahead of the 10-year auction. From 15:00 UTC the mode reverted to mixed and Tail eased through 20, 18, 17 and 15 as the gap-down was absorbed and the FOMC minutes landed. Confidence held between 86 and 89 throughout.
outlookSummary: The near-term path is treated as conditionally two-way. Risk eases from the current 14 through the cash close and the post-close and Asian hours to an 11 floor, since thin but orderly overnight trade normally still permits retracement. Risk then rebuilds across the European morning on duration sensitivity, through the 08:30 UTC Fed Waller speech, the 12:30 UTC jobless-claims release and the 13:30 UTC US cash open, where Tail reaches the 19 low-band ceiling. The one named caution block is 17:00-19:00 UTC on 8 October, covering the 30-year bond auction and the 17:40 UTC Fed Musalem speech, where Tail is lifted to 22 and then 20 in the watch band because a weak long-end auction into a 5.73% 30-year is the most credible duration-driven one-way mechanism. Every forecast hour beyond the current one frames price-path structure conditionally; none asserts observed structure.
